venue_country_policy: Country is derived from official venue city/state; other game fields retain source values.
notes: Includes NBA Cup games counted in regular-season standings; excludes the Cup championship, preseason, All-Star, play-in and playoffs.
Designated home/away labels do not guarantee the venue is in the team's home state. Cup neutral games can produce 40/42 home labels.
Game dates/locations are not a player's actual duty-day ledger. Do not infer travel, practice, residency or participation from them.
